notes.title: Patch 1.4: new game modes, 8 players, and more!
notes.content:
🎉Big update! 🎉
Hitmen Party now supports 8 players! In this patch, we also worked on improving the different mode explanations, and balancing the rules especially in Hunt, Dress-up, and Kill Them All.  We also introduced two new game modes: Crown 👑 and Paint Them All 🎨. In the former, you'll have to wear the crown for longer than the other players; in the latter, your team must paint the whole map with your color.  



Here is a non-exhaustive changelog: 

 You can now start a game with up to 8 players!


 New game modes: Crown👑, and Paint Them All🎨.


 Balancing: in Dress up, target clothes are now harder to find - there are way less than before!


 Balancing: in Dress up, players cannot start with a target cloth item (no unfair and random advantage now!)


 Balancing: in Hunt, the hunted is now harder to find - there are more doppelgangers on the map, and way more complex clothing on all pedestrians, making it visually harder for hunters.


 Balancing: in Hunt, rounds are shorter to make it easier for the hunted to win.


 Improvement: ties are now handled properly at the end of rounds and games.


 Improvement: you can now choose the next game mode at the end of the current one. No need to go back to the main menu!


 Improvement: the replay screen now gives more information in Dress up mode.



These new changes also come alongside several bug fixes, either on the UI, on spawning positions, or multiple kills with one attack.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.content:
A new update that brings more interesting PvP features to all game modes, alongside bug fixes and spanish language support.


 New dashing feature for players - allowing them to escape or track the target more easily!
 New attack with the throwing knife that lets you kill from afar - at the cost of being seen!
 Adding support for spanish language
 Fix for the Bodyguard mode UI
 Fix for a bug occurring when too many controller were connected

notes.title: Patch 1.2

notes.title: Patch notes 1.1 (Play with your phones!)
notes.content:
This is a big update as it allows players to play with their phone instead of a gamepad. There is now no excuse for not playing with 6 friends!

New features

 Gamepads are no longer required: you can play using your phone as of today! No need for having 6 Xbox controllers
 The rooftop map has been updated and allows for more interesting gameplay
 New particle sprites for advanced variant features
 You now have the option to teleport from a clothomatic to another (very good for confusing your opponents!)
 When you unlock poison, you can use it to trap interactions to kill other players
 The game now uses Rewired instead of Unity default's input system, which allows more controllers of the same type to be connected

Fixes and improvements

 Collider fixes on snowy river map
 UI fix in control screen
 Mouse is now hidden in game
 Improved english & french translations
 Better tutorial explanations

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0
notes.content:
Fixes and improvements

 Fixed several issues in colorblind mode
 Fixed typos in control canvas for gamepad
 Fixed repeated canvas scaling in Hunt game mode
 Fixed kill sound effect not playing in Dress-up game mode
 FIxed crash sometimes at round end or on player death due to clothomatic actions not terminated properly
 Improved readability on replay canvas with outlined character names
 Improved sound effect on end game canvas
